skills.name: grill-me

description.th: ทดสอบแนวคิดและแผนด้วยคำถามเป็นรอบ
description.en: Stress-test a plan through structured questions

skills.content:
Interview me to sharpen my plan or idea. Map each decision and its dependencies. In each round ask the questions whose prerequisites are already settled; number them and recommend an answer with reasons. Wait for my answers before the next round. Do not ask dependent questions before their prerequisites are answered. Research facts using available tools or supplied material; disclose missing access and never invent facts. Keep decisions with me. Continue until no important assumptions remain, then summarize our shared understanding and ask me to confirm it before acting. If I have not supplied a plan, ask what I want to explore.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

---

skills.name: wait-what

description.th: อธิบายคำตอบที่ซับซ้อนใหม่ให้เข้าใจง่าย

skills.content:
Re-explain your previous answer. Start with enough context to orient me, then use short sentences and plain, precise language. Define unfamiliar technical terms. Use consistent terminology from any project context I supplied. Give one concrete example and explain the practical implication. Preserve important qualifications. If there is no previous answer to explain, ask me to paste the text.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

skills.name: code-review

description.th: ตรวจโค้ดแยกตามมาตรฐานและความตรงกับโจทย์

skills.content:
Review the code or diff I provide along two separate axes: (1) conformance to documented project standards, including possible duplication, unclear names and unnecessary complexity; (2) conformance to the requested behavior and acceptance criteria. First establish the comparison baseline and requirement source. Request missing material that you cannot access. Report concrete findings with file locations, evidence, severity and suggested fixes. Label subjective design concerns as judgments. Keep the two axes separate, explicitly report missing specifications and untested paths, and never claim to have executed checks you did not run.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

skills.name: systematic-debugging

description.th: หาต้นเหตุของบั๊กก่อนเสนอวิธีแก้
description.en: Find root causes before proposing fixes

skills.content:
Help diagnose the bug I describe. First read the complete error, reproduce the behavior if tools allow, inspect recent changes and trace inputs and outputs across component boundaries. Compare with a working case. State one specific root-cause hypothesis and test it with the smallest discriminating check. Change one variable at a time. Only after evidence supports the cause, propose a focused fix and a regression check. Verify the original failure and relevant existing behavior. If repeated fixes fail, revisit the architecture and assumptions rather than stacking patches. Clearly distinguish observed evidence from guesses and state any unavailable tools or missing information.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

---

skills.name: writing-plans

description.th: แตกข้อกำหนดเป็นแผนงานที่ลงมือทำได้
description.en: Turn requirements into actionable implementation steps

skills.content:
Turn the supplied requirements into an implementation plan. Identify the goal, constraints, architecture, dependencies and acceptance criteria. Map the affected files or components before breaking work into small, independently testable tasks. For each task include exact known file paths, interfaces, concrete changes, verification steps and expected outcomes. Do not invent repository details: inspect available files or identify what context is missing. Keep tasks focused; avoid speculative abstractions and unnecessary work. Check that every requirement is covered, interfaces agree, and no placeholder remains. Present the plan for review before implementing it.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

skills.name: verification-before-completion

description.th: ตรวจหลักฐานก่อนสรุปว่างานสำเร็จ

skills.content:
Before claiming this work is complete, identify what fresh evidence would prove each requirement. Run the relevant full checks when tools are available, read the complete output and exit status, and compare results against acceptance criteria. A previous passing run, an intention to test, or a partial check is not proof. If evidence does not support success, report the actual state and remaining work. Distinguish tests executed from suggested manual checks, and include important untested paths or limitations. Never imply a check ran when you cannot execute it. Finish with a concise evidence-based completion report.

Respond in the language I use unless I request another language.

---
